annotation.title_clean: La Senacyt impulsa la creación de una Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial (IA) en conjunto con el gobierno, sectores productivos, la academia y la sociedad civil
annotation.title_en: Senacyt promotes the creation of a National Artificial Intelligence Strategy together with government, productive sectors, academia and civil society
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Secretaría Nacional de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Senacyt), Panamá
annotation.summary_en: Press release from Panama's Senacyt announcing a consultative process to formulate a National AI Strategy with government, industry, academia and civil society. Senacyt says it does not currently support regulation, preferring to discuss strategy first; a first draft is expected by May 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Senacyt proposes a National AI Strategy for safe, trustworthy, ethical AI and competitiveness
Senacyt does not back regulation at this time; strategy discussion comes first
Multi-sector consultation with government, guilds, academia and civil society
Challenges noted: access, human capital formation, research
